model_annotation: The plot illustrates the training rewards over steps for different policy optimization methods on both an Easy and a Hard training set. The x-axis is labeled "Steps" and represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 500, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 50. The y-axis is labeled "Training Rewards" and extends from 0 to 0.4, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. A solid black line represents the “Llama-On-Policy-Easy” method, starting at a reward of approximately 0.0 and reaching a peak of approximately 0.38 at around 200 steps. A red line, representing the “Llama-LUFFY-Easy” method, begins at a reward of approximately 0.0 and rises to a value of approximately 0.35 around 350 steps. Finally, a blue line represents the “Llama-On-Policy-Easy” method in the Hard training set, which starts at a reward of approximately 0.0 and reaches a value of approximately 0.08 at around 400 steps, and a red line, representing the “Llama-LUFFY-Hard” method begins at a reward of approximately 0.0 and reaches a value of approximately 0.05 at around 400 steps.
